explanation: The Circadian tab is split into CircadianTab (state, per-arm scan queue, selection), CircadianControls, CircadianNotes, CircadianResultsTable and ArmStatsStrip; every arm is scanned with its own gene-wise correction, peak displays share peak.ts, Lomb-Scargle floor claims require a verified projection for every scored sampling pattern, raw exports cover every listed gene, and the workbook is built in circadianWorkbook.worker.ts. CIRCADIAN_VALIDATION.md and the ui-change runbook describe the new behaviour; rhythmicity.ts and jtkCycle.ts are unchanged.
